verdicts.reason: A: the MERRY headline is shrunk to an unreadable cluster jammed against the right edge with the characters, so it now reads 'DISCOUNT MERRY'. DISCOUNT takes over as the hero, and the left quarter is empty while the right side is overcrowded. B has the same flaws: MERRY is tiny and sits below DISCOUNT, so the original reading order is reversed, and the characters are miniaturised into a crowded strip. Still, DISCOUNT is centred and the characters on each side frame it, so the space is better balanced and B is slightly less broken.
